records.label: Shared words can accompany explicit disagreement
records.paraphrase: The skeptical source restates belief/reality guidance while criticizing its repetition and ambiguity. A similarity edge to an interview therefore cannot be interpreted as agreement.

records.label: Advertising and publisher framing are present in sampled source bodies
records.paraphrase: Retail advertising occurs in the temporal middle of one interview; health-service and software promotions bracket two others, and a podcast advertisement interrupts a brief organizational-role answer. Untreated document topics can therefore describe publishing infrastructure.

records.label: Broad agency and future-contact themes include qualifications
records.paraphrase: One source limits changes to an earthly-life framework, another refuses to treat rapid developments as a settled forecast, and another portrays a contact forecast as conditional and potentially influenced by attention to it. These distinctions would disappear in a simple shared-keyword count.

records.label: A singleton component needs source-level interpretation
records.paraphrase: In the Ashtar-attributed recording, workers belongs to the spiritual compound lightworkers, jumps describes claimed timeline/vibration changes, and sole occurs where surrounding text suggests a possible recognition error involving soul. These observations explain how a component can combine genuine source-specific vocabulary and transcription noise.

records.label: A broad question family does not make answers equivalent
records.paraphrase: Contact-readiness passages address different subjects: an individual preparing for an encounter, a collective described as unready, and a selected audience described as already prepared. Their shared theme is not enough to establish agreement or contradiction.
records.type: AI comparison; human equivalence validation pending

records.label: Practical guidance has different forms across the available sources
records.paraphrase: The Bashar-context exchange clarifies a general action-and-belief formula, while the complete single Ashtar comparison presents accepting, identifying and embodying a life purpose. Paul Selig and the Daniel posts offer additional spiritual framings, but these source types are not balanced evidence about separate civilizations.

meaning: Counterexamples and comparison leads grounded in inspected windows; not population estimates or physical-origin findings
